verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Rootly has an API reference section with an API-key overview, an API changelog, and a downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger spec. Nothing documents an interactive explorer, a 'try it' playground, or runnable examples inside the reference. Downloading the spec to load into external tooling is a user-side workaround, and a static reference is only adjacent to this story, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
